purpose: Keep the clean main environment separate from mechanism-specific treatment knobs so each result has a clear interpretation.
main_invariants: no search-cost or standing-rule payoff accounting

public_solicitation.research_question: Does an explicit public opt-in path improve discovery and execution relative to restricted visible-contact trading?
do_not_mix_with: automatic all-agent response unless labeled as an upper bound

steps.interpretation: Measures restricted-contact execution without public solicitation.
Tests whether controllers can choose to create a public opt-in response path.

steps.single_change_from_previous: tighten the same visibility/contact channel to one weak visible contact per controller
steps.interpretation: Single-pressure diagnostic: restricted visibility creates a real discovery gap, while public opt-in remains controller-created.

steps.single_change_from_previous: diagnostic bundle from PS1b: use two visible contacts, consent-subset finalization, and LLM private acceptance; deterministic IR auto-blocking remains off
steps.interpretation: Tests whether hidden responses can convert into execution when independent consented rows may clear without an all-or-nothing failure.
Upper-bound diagnostic: public response is granted automatically, so this should not be used as the main treatment.
Separates gross welfare capture from net welfare after public-search cost accounting.

explicit_rule_savings_affordance.research_question: If persistent public rules are explicitly made payoff-relevant, can agents create and reuse one?
do_not_mix_with: automatic all-agent response unless labeled as an upper bound

steps.single_change_from_previous: add recurring demand and public-search cost to the PS1c protocol shape, with no payoff savings for codified public rules
steps.interpretation: Control arm: tests recurring/search pressure without directly making persistent public rules cheaper in later rounds.

steps.single_change_from_previous: same as the no-savings arm, except active codified public rules save 0.2 total coordination cost per later round
steps.interpretation: Treatment arm: isolates whether a payoff advantage for reusable public state increases T0 codified-rule emergence.

indirect_routing_pressure.research_question: Does persistent public state emerge when broad response routing is costly but targeted routing to known counterparties is cheaper, without any direct rule bonus?
do_not_mix_with: automatic all-agent response unless labeled as an upper bound

steps.single_change_from_previous: replace flat public-round search cost and rule savings with per-contact response cost; persistent public rules receive no direct bonus
steps.interpretation: Clean emergence arm: public state only helps if agents use it to route later requests to fewer relevant agents.

protocol_fragility.research_question: Does the amend/finalize/private-accept pipeline itself prevent execution?

steps.interpretation: Exact consent once plus deterministic IR safety.

steps.single_change_from_previous: legacy stress arm with amend/finalize/private-accept and anti-anchor
steps.interpretation: Stress/robustness comparison only; too confounded for main inference.
